Note that I am 95% sure they are right about it, I'm not trying to deny the mantle or anything like that.

There are many ways to know something exists. Most of what we know about Earth's interior comes from detailed seismology measurements. Note that we know what it's made from because we know exactly what its properties (density compressibility etc) are.

Digging it up and looking at it is just another form of measurement. It doesn't turn something from "theoretical" to "not theoretical", no such distinction really exists, just a long slow gradient of certainty.
